messages:
alex_cs: FYI — OmniaSearch opened a ticket this morning. They see a spike of 429s on /v1/embeddings.batch after the 02:40 deploy. Included repro steps and logs. Please triage, customer-impacting.

alex_cs: TL;DR: Customer: OmniaSearch (prod). Symptom: ~20-30% of batched embedding requests returning 429, occasional responses with fewer vectors than inputs. First seen 2026-03-18 ~02:50 UTC (after deploy). Repro pattern: batch_size=16 + concurrency=8.

alex_cs: Repro steps they gave: 1) Build payload with 16 strings. 2) Concurrently send 8 POSTs to /v1/embeddings.batch. 3) Observe intermittent 429s and some responses with 12 vectors instead of 16.

alex_cs: Minimal curl they used:
```\ncurl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings.batch\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"model":"rwd-embedding-v1","inputs":["q1","q2",...,"q16"]}'\n```

alex_cs: Snippet from their logs (redacted ids):
- 2026-03-18T02:51:02Z request_id=omni-req-001 status=200 batch=16 vectors=16
- 2026-03-18T02:51:03Z request_id=omni-req-002 status=429 route=/v1/embeddings.batch bucket=embed-batch
- 2026-03-18T02:51:03Z request_id=omni-req-003 status=200 batch=16 vectors=12

jamie_sales: OmniaSearch is an enterprise pilot — GTM priority. If this continues they may pause trials and ask for Dedicated. :warning:

sarah_pm: Need severity. Is this full outage or partial degradation? Also decide rollback vs patch.

alex_cs: Customer: partial (not full outage) but causes ranking noise for a subset of queries. They prefer quick rollback if runtime change is root cause. Escalated.

mike_eng: I'll take first look. Please attach full request/response bodies + request_ids and headers (rate-limit buckets, X-Route).

alex_cs: Linked CS-7842 -> ENG-11234 and uploaded sample payload + Python snippet.

deploy-bot: Deployed inference-runtime v2.4.1 (commit abc123) to prod at 2026-03-18T02:40:12Z

mike_eng: Hypothesis: v2.4.1 changed batching internals (split/merge) or rate-limiter semantics for batched endpoints. Under concurrency, sub-batches may be dropped during assembly.

mike_eng: Triage plan: reproduce in staging with batch=16 & concurrency=8; enable verbose batch logs and kv-cache metadata; if reproducible, try revert to confirm regression.

alex_cs: Customer can join a debug window today at 15:00 UTC for live captures.

jamie_sales: Requesting 72h SLA from GTM. Mitigation options: reduce concurrency to 2 or batch to 8 — they said that helps but increases cost.

sarah_pm: If regression affecting pilots, mark P1. Loop in SRE/eng-infra for rollback playbook.

eng-infra-bot: Rollback checklist: 1) verify canary health, 2) drain new runtime pods, 3) redeploy v2.4.0 image tag, 4) monitor token-level latency and error spikes. ETA ~30-45m once approved.

mike_eng: @alex_cs paste exact 16-item payload and request ids into ENG-11234. Also need their concurrency snippet.

alex_cs: Done — payload + snippet in ENG-11234. Python snippet shows ThreadPoolExecutor with max_workers=8 posting the same 16 inputs.

mike_eng: Reproducing in staging now. If reproducible I'll attach traces & minimal failing test. If not, we'll request a prod capture window.

alex_cs: Customer confirmed 15:00 UTC debug window; scheduled on the ticket.

mike_eng: Update: reproduced in staging — intermittent 429s and truncated vectors observed. Collected logs with batch metadata and route tags; uploaded to ENG-11234.

mike_eng: Preliminary root cause: during high-concurrency merging of sub-batches, a soft reject from the rate-limiter causes the assembly code to skip item indices without surfacing an error to the top-level batch. Result: 200 with missing vectors or 429 depending on timing.

mike_eng: Short-term mitigations: 1) tighten batch-assembly to fail if any items dropped (surface explicit error), 2) prepare revert of the batching commit in v2.4.1 as fallback.

sarah_pm: Decision matrix: if a hotfix can be tested + canaried within 1h -> hotfix. If hotfix >1h or risky -> rollback. Keep GTM/Sales updated.

mike_eng: Working on PR to validate assembly and surface errors. If tests pass I'll push a hotfix branch and request emergency canary; else we rollback.

jamie_sales: I'll tell OmniaSearch we'll attempt rollback if needed and offer mitigation. They want ETA within 3h for decision.

alex_cs: I'll update the customer: reproduced in staging, engineering has a reproducer and is evaluating rollback vs hotfix. Will confirm within 3h.

mike_eng: Note: customer reported lowering concurrency to 2 or batch to 8 mitigates the issue — useful temporary mitigation.

alex_cs: Customer prefers hotfix if rollback disrupts other pilots. Asking for mitigation doc in the meantime.

mike_eng: I'll post PR and canary results to ENG-11234. Will join 15:00 UTC window for prod traces if needed.

alex_cs: Closing internal thread — ENG-11234 is the source of truth. Will paste customer-facing updates after internal decision.

deploy-bot: ENG-11234 updated with staging logs and reproducer artifacts at 2026-03-18T10:12:07Z
